verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's docs explicitly describe automatic stale flag detection ('GrowthBook can automatically detect these flags so you can clean them up') as a dedicated feature, directly addressing the story of finding stale flags for removal. This is corroborated by the product's broader flag-management infrastructure (environments, rules, revisions) but lacks detail on code-reference scanning across repos or independent/hands-on verification of the stale-detection feature itself. Missing for 10: evidence of code-reference/usage scanning across the codebase, and independent/community confirmation that stale detection works reliably in practice.
